# Dick Moore

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Mary / Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Sailor and store clerk  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Dick was a big, handsome man with a sea-going streak. He had a unique family trait regarding his eyes, having one blue eye and one hazel eye, a feature shared by his cousin George. Prior to his death, he was lean with light hair and high color.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick was described as having a big, handsome exterior but a little, ugly soul. He was persistent in pursuing what he wanted until he obtained it, after which he lost interest. Though often pleasant and agreeable when things went well, he drank heavily, was a born tyrant, and was disliked by many in the community.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

- Persistent  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

## History

Dick Moore grew up at the Glen, where his father Abner kept a store. He became obsessed with Leslie West and forced her into marrying him by threatening to have his father foreclose the mortgage on her mother's farm. After living with Leslie for one winter on the West farm, he grew tired of quiet married life and left for Nova Scotia. There he joined his cousin George Moore aboard the ship Four Sisters bound for Havana. While in Cuba, Dick contracted yellow fever and died thirteen years prior to the events of Four Winds. His cousin George stayed behind to nurse him, missed the ship's departure, and subsequently suffered an injury that caused loss of memory, leading everyone in Four Winds to mistake George for Dick for twelve years.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)_
